prompt: I feel nauseous after starting a new medication. What should I do?
response: Nausea can happen with some medications, but your next step depends on your symptoms and prescription details. Keep track of when symptoms happen and any warning signs. This information can help your healthcare provider decide what is appropriate. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Please consult your healthcare provider before changing medication use, and contact emergency services if symptoms feel severe or urgent.
